definition: a scene of uproar and confusion
hook: Bedlam is chaos. But it started as an address.
modernAnchor: A stadium after a last-second goal. A trading floor at open. We call it bedlam.

origin.originalMeaning: the Hospital of St. Mary of Bethlehem, London

journey: In 1247, a priory was founded in London dedicated to the Virgin Mary of Bethlehem.
By the 1400s it had become England's first institution for the mentally ill.
Londoners shortened Bethlehem to Bethlem, then to Bedlam. The name followed the reputation.
Conditions were so wretched that paying visitors came to watch the patients. It was a spectacle.
